title_en: Dongfang Company (Nanning Office) v. Wuyangshen Company et al. — dispute over loan guarantee contract
ruling_gist_en: Where an enterprise is restructured by means of employees fully funding the purchase of net assets, such restructuring constitutes a change in the nature and name of the legal person's capital contributor, etc., and does not affect the enterprise's assumption of civil liability for debts incurred prior to the restructuring.
keywords_en: Civil; Dispute over loan guarantee contract; Second instance; Supreme People's Court; Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region; Guizhou Province; Legal person; Financial institution; Contract Law; Guarantee Law; Assumption of debts after enterprise restructuring; Period of suretyship liability; Validity of mortgage guarantee; Partial support; Loan contract; Guarantee contract; Enterprise restructuring; Assignment of claims; Contract dispute; Guarantee; Dispute over loan guarantee contract involving Shen Company and others
full_text_en:
Dongfang Company Nanning Office v. Wuyangshen Company et al. — Dispute over Loan Guarantee Contract

【Ruling Summary】

Where an enterprise undergoes restructuring by having its employees fully purchase its net assets with their own funds, this constitutes a change in the nature and name of the legal person’s contributing entity, and does not affect the enterprise’s civil liability for debts incurred prior to the restructuring.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2003) Min Er Zhong Zi No. 47

Appellant (Plaintiff at First Instance): China Orient Asset Management Corporation, Nanning Office. Domicile: Nanning City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

Person in Charge: Ji Shuwen, General Manager of the Office.

Agent ad litem: Liu Zonglun, Lawyer, Chenghe Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Wang Yongjing, Lawyer, Chenghe Law Firm.

Appellees (Defendants at First Instance):

1. Guizhou Wuyangshen Vegetable Oil Co., Ltd. Domicile: Wulibei, Wuyang Town, Zhenyuan County, Guizhou Province.

Legal Representative: Yang Lixin, Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Zhao Shujian, Lawyer, Yuanzheng Law Firm.

2. Guizhou Qingjiu Group Co., Ltd. Domicile: Wulipai, Qingxi Town, Zhenyuan County, Guizhou Province.

Legal Representative: Wen Yichang, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Yao Yuanbin, Staff of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Liu Zhifei, Lawyer, Guizhou Tieli Law Firm.

3. Zhenyuan County Building Materials Chemical Company. Domicile: Zhenyuan County, Guizhou Province.

Legal Representative: Wang Yi, Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Li Guangkun, Director of Zhenyuan County Economic and Trade Bureau.

Defendants at First Instance:

1. Xingda Smelter. Domicile: Zhenyuan County, Guizhou Province.

Legal Representative: Yin Songlin, Factory Director.

2. Zhenyuan County Dongxia Power Plant. Domicile: Zhenyuan County, Guizhou Province.

Legal Representative: Li Xinguo, Factory Director.

3. Southeast Guizhou Prefecture Local Power Company. Domicile: Zhenyuan County, Guizhou Province.

Legal Representative: Peng Xiansi, Factory Director of the Company.

The appellant, China Orient Asset Management Corporation Nanning Office, dissatisfied with the Civil Judgment (2002) Qian Gao Min Er Chu Zi No. 14 rendered by the Guizhou High People’s Court in the dispute over loan guarantee contracts involving the appellees Guizhou Wuyangshen Vegetable Oil Co., Ltd., Guizhou Qingjiu Group Co., Ltd., Zhenyuan County Building Materials Chemical Company, and the defendants at first instance Xingda Smelter, Zhenyuan County Dongxia Power Plant, and Southeast Guizhou Prefecture Local Power Company, appealed to this Court. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law, composed of Presiding Judge Wu Qingbao, Acting Judges Gong Bangyou and Liu Min, to hear the case. Court Clerk Kong Ling served as the recorder. The case has now been concluded.

The court of first instance found the following facts:

Since 1993, the Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou Branch of Bank of China (hereinafter referred to as Guizhou BOC), and Kaili Sub-branch of Bank of China (hereinafter referred to as Kaili BOC), jointly or separately, entered into the following loan contracts with Guizhou Zhenyuan County Oil and Fat Chemical Plant (later renamed Guizhou Wuyangshen Vegetable Oil Co., Ltd., hereinafter referred to as the Oil and Fat Plant and Wuyangshen Company, respectively):

1. On September 3, 1993, the Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC jointly entered into a "Bank of China Renminbi Three-Level Joint Loan Contract" with the Oil and Fat Plant, stipulating that the Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC would jointly provide a loan of RMB 15.72 million to the Oil and Fat Plant. Specifically, RMB 10 million from the Head Office, RMB 3.5 million from Guizhou BOC, and RMB 2.22 million from Kaili BOC; the loan term was three years, from September 1993 to September 1996; the loan interest rate was calculated according to the annual loan interest rate prescribed by the People's Bank of China; the repayment plan for the Oil and Fat Plant was RMB 4,579,700 in 1996, RMB 6,427,500 in 1997, and RMB 5,072,500 in 1998. On this contract, in addition to the seals of the lender and borrower, Guizhou Qingxi Distillery (hereinafter referred to as Qingxi Distillery), Guizhou Southeast Guizhou Prefecture Hongqi Hydropower Plant (hereinafter referred to as Hongqi Power Plant), and Guizhou Zhenyuan County Dongxia Power Plant (hereinafter referred to as Dongxia Power Plant) all affixed their seals in the guarantor column. On the same day, Hongqi Power Plant, Qingxi Distillery, and Dongxia Power Plant entered into a "Renminbi 'Three-Level Joint Loan' Guarantee Agreement" with the Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC, stating that the guarantee documents issued by the guarantors must be unconditional and irrevocable; their liability commenced from the effective date of the contract until the full repayment of the loan principal, interest, and expenses; Hongqi Power Plant guaranteed RMB 6 million, Qingxi Distillery guaranteed RMB 4 million, and Dongxia Power Plant guaranteed RMB 5.72 million. On April 29, 1994, the Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC entered into a mortgage guarantee document with the Oil and Fat Plant, stipulating that the Oil and Fat Plant would provide its imported daily processing capacity 50-ton refined oil equipment as mortgage security for the RMB 15.72 million loan from the Head Office, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC. This mortgage was registered with the Zhenyuan County Administration for Industry and Commerce on July 18, 1997. After the contracts were signed, the Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC disbursed the above loans as agreed.

Kaili BOC and China Orient Asset Management Corporation Nanning Office (hereinafter referred to as Orient Asset Nanning Office) issued overdue loan collection notices to Wuyangshen Company on February 18, 1998, March 12, 2000, November 6, 2000, and April 20, 2001, all of which were signed and received by Wuyangshen Company. Kaili BOC and Orient Asset Nanning Office issued collection notices to Qingxi Distillery on December 2, 1999, December 27, 2000, and December 27, 2001; they issued a notarized collection notice to Hongqi Power Plant on December 27, 2000; and issued collection notices to Dongxia Power Plant on March 25, 1999, August 22, 2000, and December 28, 2000.

2. On November 7, 1994, the Oil and Fat Plant entered into a medium-term short-term loan contract for export commodities with Kaili BOC, stipulating that Kaili BOC would grant a loan of RMB 2.72 million to the Oil and Fat Plant for the introduction of refined oil equipment to develop a high-grade edible oil technical renovation project, with a term of three years and a monthly interest rate of 10.2‰. On October 5, 1994, and November 7, 1994, Guizhou Zhenyuan County Cement Plant (hereinafter referred to as Cement Plant) and Guizhou Zhenyuan County Smelter (hereinafter referred to as Smelter) each issued a guarantee document to Kaili BOC, stating that the Cement Plant and the Smelter would each provide joint and several guarantees for the principal and interest of the RMB 2.72 million loan granted by Kaili BOC to the Oil and Fat Plant; the guarantee documents would be valid from the date of issuance until the borrower had repaid all outstanding loan principal and interest in full. On the same day, Kaili BOC entered into a mortgage guarantee document with Wuyangshen Company, stipulating that the Oil and Fat Plant would provide its oil dispensing room and equipment, three Dongfeng trucks, guesthouse, Jiaoxi office building, and sewage treatment station as mortgage security for the RMB 2.72 million loan granted by Kaili BOC to the Oil and Fat Plant. This mortgage was registered with the Zhenyuan County Administration for Industry and Commerce on July 18, 1997. After the contract was signed, Kaili BOC disbursed the above loan to the Oil and Fat Plant.

Kaili BOC and Orient Asset Nanning Office issued overdue loan collection notices to Wuyangshen Company on February 12, 1998, March 5, 1999, December 1, 1999, November 6, 2000, and April 20, 2001, all of which were signed and received by Wuyangshen Company. Kaili BOC and Orient Asset Nanning Office issued overdue loan collection notices to the Cement Plant on December 3, 1999, and August 22, 2000, which were signed and received by the Cement Plant. Kaili BOC and Orient Asset Nanning Office issued notarized collection notices to Xingda Smelter in March 1999, December 1999, December 29, 2000, and December 29, 2001.

3. On October 9, 1995, Wuyangshen Company entered into a Renminbi fund loan contract with Kaili BOC, contract number (1995) Kai Zhong Yin Xin Zi No. 64, stipulating that Kaili BOC would grant a loan of RMB 1.5 million to Wuyangshen Company, with a monthly interest rate of 12.06‰ and a loan term of 8 months, from October 9, 1995, to June 9, 1996. On the same day, Wuyangshen Company entered into a mortgage contract with Kaili BOC, number (1995) Kai Zhong Yin Xin Zi No. 64, stipulating that Wuyangshen Company would provide its refining workshop and No. 1 warehouse as mortgage security for the above loan. This mortgage was registered with the Zhenyuan County Administration for Industry and Commerce on July 18, 1997.

Kaili BOC and Orient Asset Nanning Office issued overdue loan collection notices to Wuyangshen Company on February 8, 1997, February 19, 1998, March 5, 1999, December 1, 1999, March 12, 2000, November 6, 2000, and April 20, 2001, all of which were signed and received by Wuyangshen Company.

4. On October 12, 1995, Wuyangshen Company entered into a Renminbi loan contract with Kaili BOC, contract number (1995) Kai Zhong Yin Xin Zi No. 66, stipulating that Kaili BOC would grant a loan of RMB 1.5 million to Wuyangshen Company, with a monthly interest rate of 12.06‰ and a term of 8 months, from October 12, 1995, to June 12, 1996. On the same day, Wuyangshen Company entered into a mortgage contract with Kaili BOC, number (1995) Kai Zhong Yin Xin Zi No. 66, stipulating that the Oil and Fat Plant would provide its extraction workshop building, equipment, and inspection and chemical building as mortgage security for the above loan. This mortgage was registered with the Zhenyuan County Administration for Industry and Commerce on July 18, 1997. After the contract was signed, Kaili BOC disbursed the above loan as agreed.

Kaili BOC and Orient Asset Nanning Office issued overdue loan collection notices to Wuyangshen Company on February 8, 1997, February 19, 1998, March 5, 1999, December 1, 1999, March 12, 2000, November 6, 2000, and April 20, 2001, all of which were signed and received by Wuyangshen Company.

5. On October 15, 1995, Wuyangshen Company entered into a Renminbi fund loan contract with Kaili BOC, contract number (1995) Kai Zhong Yin Xin Zi No. 67, stipulating that Kaili BOC would grant a loan of RMB 1.3 million to Wuyangshen Company, with a monthly interest rate of 12.06‰ and a term of 9 months, from October 15, 1995, to July 15, 1996. On the same day, Wuyangshen Company entered into a mortgage contract with Kaili BOC, number (1995) Kai Zhong Yin Xin Zi No. 67, stipulating that the Oil and Fat Plant would provide its inspection and chemical building as mortgage security for the above loan. However, this mortgage was not registered with the relevant authorities.

Kaili BOC and Orient Asset Nanning Office issued overdue loan collection notices to Wuyangshen Company on February 8, 1997, February 9, 1998, March 5, 1999, December 1, 1999, March 12, 2000, and April 20, 2001, all of which were signed and received by Wuyangshen Company.

It was further found: In March 1993, the Cement Plant was renamed Zhenyuan County Building Materials Chemical Company (hereinafter referred to as Jianhua Company), and the seal of the Cement Plant was simultaneously declared void. In August 1996, the Smelter was renamed Xingda Smelter. Hongqi Power Plant was subsequently merged into Southeast Guizhou Prefecture Local Power Company (hereinafter referred to as Power Company). On September 13, 2000, the People's Government of Zhenyuan County (hereinafter referred to as Zhenyuan County Government) issued Zhen Fu Han [2000] No. 24, "Reply of the County People's Government on the Approval of the Property Rights System Reform Plan of Qingxi Distillery," approving the restructuring of Qingxi Distillery. The attached property rights system reform plan of Qingxi Distillery stated that the restructuring of Qingxi Distillery was carried out in accordance with the requirements of "the state transferring property rights, the enterprise transforming its mechanism, and employees changing their status," whereby all regular on-duty employees of Qingxi Distillery would fully purchase the state-owned net assets of Qingxi Distillery with their own funds, restructuring Qingxi Distillery from a state-owned enterprise into a limited liability company. The original enterprise's debts and claims would be assumed by the new shareholders (to be borne by the restructured enterprise). The enterprise would combine capital cooperation and labor cooperation, and distribution according to labor and dividends according to shares. The net asset transfer income of Qingxi Distillery would be included in the state-owned assets management of the Zhenyuan County Government and used for reinvestment of state-owned assets. After assessment, the total assets of Qingxi Distillery were RMB 102.886 million (excluding land and commercial intangible assets), total debts were RMB 84.949 million, and net assets were RMB 17.937 million (excluding land and commercial intangible assets). The transfer price of land use rights would be determined after further assessment. Until the transfer, the new enterprise could use the land free of charge until December 31, 2000. If the transfer had not occurred by that time, the new enterprise should pay usage fees to the county government in accordance with relevant regulations until the transfer was completed. Goodwill intangible assets were temporarily not assessed. The new enterprise would pay an annual rent of RMB 100,000 to the government. Subsequent assessment would be based on the actual transfer price at the end of February 2000, with any increase thereafter belonging to the new enterprise. The new enterprise shareholders, led by Wen Yichang, paid the corresponding consideration and obtained other property rights of Qingxi Distillery except for land use rights and trademark rights, and registered with the administrative authority for industry and commerce to establish Guizhou Qingjiu Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Qingjiu Group). On October 28 of the same year, Qingxi Distillery was deregistered by the Zhenyuan County administrative authority for industry and commerce.

The above loans totaled five tranches, with an aggregate principal amount of RMB 22.74 million. The lenders performed their obligation to disburse the loans as agreed, but the borrowers and guarantors failed to perform their repayment obligations. On June 22, 2000, Guizhou BOC and Orient Asset Nanning Office entered into a creditor's rights transfer agreement, transferring the above five tranches of claims totaling RMB 22.74 million to Orient Asset Nanning Office. On July 5, 2002, Orient Asset Nanning Office filed a lawsuit with the Guizhou High People's Court, requesting a judgment ordering Wuyangshen Company to repay the outstanding principal of RMB 24,355,403.39 and corresponding interest (interest tentatively calculated as of March 31, 2000, at RMB 9,078,563.56), and that Orient Asset Nanning Office be entitled to priority compensation from the mortgaged property of Wuyangshen Company; that Qingxi Distillery, Jianhua Company, Smelter, Dongxia Power Plant, and Power Company each bear joint and several liability for repayment of the loans within their respective guarantee scopes; and that the litigation costs be borne by Wuyangshen Company. During the first instance, Orient Asset Nanning Office applied to the Guizhou High People's Court to add Qingjiu Group as a co-defendant, on the grounds that Qingjiu Group was established through the restructuring of Qingxi Distillery, and requested a judgment ordering Qingjiu Group to bear corresponding joint and several guarantee liability for the above debts.

The Guizhou High People's Court held in its trial that the five loan contracts entered into by the Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC with the Oil and Fat Plant, and the guarantee contracts entered into with Qingxi Distillery, Dongxia Power Plant, Hongqi Power Plant, Cement Plant, and Xingda Smelter were all genuine expressions of the parties' intent, did not violate mandatory legal provisions, and should be legally valid. The Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC had performed their obligations as lenders as agreed. However, the Oil and Fat Plant failed to repay the loan principal and interest on time. With respect to these several loans, there was evidence that Orient Asset Nanning Office had issued collection notices within the statute of limitations. Since Wuyangshen Company was merely a name change from the Oil and Fat Plant, and the parties did not dispute this, Wuyangshen Company should bear civil liability to the Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC for repayment of the loan principal and interest as agreed. Orient Asset Nanning Office alleged in its complaint that the Head Office of Bank of China had increased the principal of RMB 10 million by converting interest into principal, bringing it to RMB 11,615,403.39. Because Orient Asset Nanning Office failed to provide relevant supporting evidence and the principal debtor Wuyangshen Company denied this, the court did not confirm this claim. With respect to the written mortgage contract signed on April 29, 1994, whereby the Oil and Fat Plant provided its daily processing capacity 50-ton refined oil equipment as mortgage security for the RMB 15.72 million loan under the "Bank of China Renminbi Three-Level Joint Loan Contract" with the Head Office of Bank of China, Guizhou BOC, and Kaili BOC; and the written mortgage contract signed on November 7, 1994, whereby the Oil and Fat Plant provided its oil dispensing room and equipment, Dongfeng trucks, guesthouse, Jiaoxi office building, and sewage treatment station as mortgage security for the RMB 2.72 million loan under the "Medium-Term Short-Term Loan Contract for Export Commodities" with Kaili BOC, pursuant to Article 112 of the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, these mortgage relationships were established. Moreover, the parties subsequently registered the above mortgaged items. Therefore, Orient Asset Nanning Office is entitled to priority compensation over the above mortgaged property. With respect to the mortgage contracts signed on October 9, 12, and 15, 1995, whereby the Oil and Fat Plant provided its refining workshop, No. 1 warehouse, extraction workshop building, equipment, and inspection and chemical building as mortgage security for the loans of RMB 1.5 million, RMB 1.5 million, and RMB 1.3 million under the (1995) Kai Zhong Yin Xin Zi Nos. 64, 65, and 66 loan contracts with Kaili BOC, the parties had registered the above mortgaged items with the administrative authority for industry and commerce. Pursuant to Article 42(2) of the Security Law of the People's Republic of China, it should be deemed that the administrative authority for industry and commerce could handle the mortgage registration of the above items. Therefore, Orient Asset Nanning Office is entitled to priority

right to receive payment. Since the guaranty acts of Qingxi Distillery, Dongxia Power Plant, Red Flag Power Plant, Cement Plant, and Smelter all occurred before the implementation of the Guaranty Law, their acts shall be governed by the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Issues Concerning Guaranty in the Trial of Economic Contract Disputes. Since none of the guaranty contracts they signed specified a guaranty period, according to Articles 11 and 29 of the above provisions, the interruption of the statute of limitations for the principal debt shall also interrupt the statute of limitations for the guaranty debt. As the debts guaranteed by the above guarantors to Nanning Office of Oriental Asset have not exceeded the statute of limitations, the above guarantors shall bear guaranty liability to Nanning Office of Oriental Asset in accordance with the contract. The guarantors' defenses that they should not bear guaranty liability are untenable and are not supported by this court. Since the guaranty liability of Qingxi Distillery, Dongxia Power Plant, and Red Flag Power Plant under the RMB "Three-Level Joint Loan" Guaranty Agreement is not clearly specified, according to Article 2 of the above provisions, if a guaranty contract does not specify the type of guaranty liability to be borne by the guarantor, or if the specification is unclear, the guarantor shall be deemed to bear compensation liability. Therefore, Qingxi Distillery, Dongxia Power Plant, and Red Flag Power Plant shall bear compensation liability within the respective guaranteed amounts when the property of Wuyangshen Company is insufficient to repay the debts. Nanning Office of Oriental Asset's request for these three enterprises to bear joint and several liability is untenable and shall be dismissed. Since there is no evidence that Qingjiu Group acquired the assets of Qingxi Distillery without consideration after the latter's restructuring, Nanning Office of Oriental Asset's claim that Qingjiu Group should succeed to the civil liability of Qingxi Distillery is untenable and is dismissed by this court. As Qingxi Distillery has been deregistered, Nanning Office of Oriental Asset may seek the assumption of its debts in separate proceedings. After Red Flag Power Plant was merged by the Power Company, its debts shall be settled by the Power Company. Cement Plant was dissolved in 1993, and its official seal was declared invalid. Therefore, the guaranty act of Cement Plant affixing its seal for the RMB 2.72 million loan from Kaili City Branch of Bank of China to Oil Factory on October 5, 1994, shall be deemed unrelated to Jianhua Company. Jianhua Company's assertion that it should not bear liability is established. The issue of who should bear the guaranty liability for this loan may also be resolved by Nanning Office of Oriental Asset in separate proceedings. Since Xingda Smelter is only a name change of Smelter, Xingda Smelter shall succeed to the creditor's rights and debts of the former Smelter. Xingda Smelter's defense of not bearing guaranty liability is untenable. In accordance with Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Guaranty Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 112 of the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China (Trial Implementation), and Articles 11 and 29 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Issues Concerning Guaranty in the Trial of Economic Contract Disputes, this court hereby rules: 1. Wuyangshen Company shall, within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, repay Nanning Office of Oriental Asset the principal of RMB 22.74 million and interest (interest during the contract term shall be calculated at the rate agreed in the contract; overdue interest shall be calculated according to the overdue payment penalty rate published by the People's Bank of China for the corresponding period until the date of full payment); Nanning Office of Oriental Asset shall have priority in receiving payment from the mortgaged property; 2. Dongxia Power Plant shall, when the mortgaged property of Wuyangshen Company and its 50-ton refined oil processing equipment is insufficient to repay the debts, bear compensation liability for the principal and interest of RMB 5.72 million; 3. Power Company shall, when the mortgaged property of Wuyangshen Company and its 50-ton refined oil processing equipment is insufficient to repay the debts, bear compensation liability for the principal and interest of RMB 6 million; 4. Xingda Smelter shall, when the mortgaged property of Wuyangshen Company, including the oil delivery room and equipment, Dongfeng vehicles, guest house, Jiaoxi office, and wastewater treatment station, is insufficient to repay the debts, bear joint and several guaranty liability for the principal and interest of RMB 2.72 million; 5. Other claims of Nanning Office of Oriental Asset are dismissed. The court acceptance fee of the first instance is RMB 88,589.92, to be borne by Wuyangshen Company.

Nanning Office of Oriental Asset, dissatisfied with the above civil judgment of the Guizhou High People's Court, appealed to this court, asserting: 1. The conversion of interest into principal is based on financial laws, regulations, and policies, and is not a fact to be proven; Nanning Office of Oriental Asset does not bear the burden of proof. The state stipulates that compound interest should be calculated on overdue bank loans. The total creditor's rights after conversion of interest into principal and then calculating interest on the new principal is the same as the total creditor's rights if compound interest were calculated on the original interest without conversion. Whether interest is converted into principal does not affect the debtor's interests. Wuyangshen Company repeatedly signed the collection notices and creditor's rights confirmation letters that recorded the principal balance after the conversion of interest into principal, thereby acknowledging the fact of conversion. The trial court erroneously denied Nanning Office of Oriental Asset's claim for the principal of RMB 1,615,403.39 on the grounds that Nanning Office of Oriental Asset did not provide relevant evidence for its assertion that the Bank of China head office had converted interest into principal for the RMB 10 million loan, increasing the principal to RMB 11,615,403.39, and that Wuyangshen Company did not admit this. This should be corrected. 2. The shareholders of Qingjiu Group, by purchasing the net assets of Qingxi Distillery, carried out property rights reform of Qingxi Distillery. There is no issue of acquiring assets with or without consideration between Qingjiu Group and Qingxi Distillery; rather, it is a general succession of rights and obligations. Changes in the internal property rights of a legal person do not affect its external civil liability. The change of registration of Qingxi Distillery to Qingjiu Group is a result of enterprise alteration, not a new establishment. Unless the pre-reform enterprise liquidated its creditor's rights and debts, the post-reform enterprise shall assume the pre-reform enterprise's creditor's rights and debts. Moreover, the property rights reform plan of Qingxi Distillery clearly states that its creditor's rights and debts shall be assumed by the post-reform enterprise. Relevant state regulations also clearly stipulate that after the sale of an enterprise, the purchaser shall continue to bear the original enterprise's guaranty liability. Therefore, Qingjiu Group should assume the guaranty liability of Qingxi Distillery in this case. The Zhenyuan County Government, without conducting liquidation of Qingxi Distillery, made a decision to dissolve it and recovered the land and trademark rights of Qingxi Distillery. The people's court should notify the Zhenyuan County Government to participate in the litigation and bear liability for the guaranty debt in proportion to the recovered property's share of Qingxi Distillery's total property. The trial court's decision to dismiss Nanning Office of Oriental Asset's claim against Qingjiu Group on the grounds that there was no evidence that Qingjiu Group had acquired Qingxi Distillery's assets without consideration, and its failure to add the Zhenyuan County Government as a co-defendant in accordance with the law, are not in compliance with legal provisions. 3. After Cement Plant was renamed Jianhua Company in 1993, it did not invalidate and cease using the Cement Plant seal; instead, it continued to use it together with the Jianhua Company seal for a long period, both representing the enterprise. The affixing of the Cement Plant seal on the RMB 2.72 million loan guaranty contract was done by the relevant responsible personnel of Jianhua Company; therefore, providing guaranty for this loan was the true intention of Jianhua Company, and Jianhua Company shall bear guaranty liability. Even if the guaranty relationship is deemed not established due to Jianhua Company's intentional use of the replaced old seal, Jianhua Company should still bear compensation liability. We request that the court of second instance amend the judgment according to law.

The appellee, Wuyangshen Company, did not submit a written defense but stated during cross-examination at trial: The increase of the principal by RMB 1,615,403.39 due to the conversion of interest into principal for the RMB 10 million loan from the Bank of China head office was not consented to by it, and it does not recognize this.

The appellee, Qingjiu Group, defended: Qingjiu Group acquired the property rights of Qingxi Distillery by paying monetary funds and assuming specific debts; it was for consideration. The debts of RMB 84.947 million it assumed were assumed in accordance with the property rights transfer agreement and are not a general succession of debts. The scope of debts stipulated in the property rights transfer agreement is clear and does not include the guaranty debts involved in this case; therefore, Qingjiu Group should not bear this guaranty liability. Qingjiu Group was established as a new enterprise legal person after 199 natural persons, represented by Wen Yichang, acquired the property ownership of Qingxi Distillery for consideration and used the acquired property as capital contribution. It has no continuation or subordinate relationship with Qingxi Distillery. Qingxi Distillery had already liquidated its assets before the property rights were transferred, and the Zhenyuan County Government transferred Qingxi Distillery based on the appraisal results. The transferee does not have rights to creditor's rights omitted from the liquidation, nor does it have the obligation to assume omitted debts. The property ownership of Qingxi Distillery has been recovered by the Zhenyuan County Government in the form of monetary funds; therefore, the guaranty liability of Qingxi Distillery in this case should be borne by the Zhenyuan County Government. The appeal ground of Nanning Office of Oriental Asset, that Qingjiu Group should bear guaranty liability because it accepted the property of Qingxi Distillery, should be dismissed. We request that the original judgment be upheld.

The appellee, Jianhua Company, did not submit a written defense either but stated during cross-examination at trial: Cement Plant was renamed Jianhua Company in 1993. The Cement Plant seal affixed on the guaranty contract and the collection notices was an invalid seal and cannot create legal liability for Jianhua Company.

In the second instance, this court does not affirm the facts found in the first instance regarding the assignment of creditor's rights between Guizhou Branch of Bank of China and Nanning Office of Oriental Asset and the declaration of invalidity of the Cement Plant seal, but affirms the other facts found in the first instance. This court additionally finds in the second instance: On September 15, 1999, a supplementary agreement on a loan contract between Wuyangshen Company and Kaili City Branch of Bank of China stated that Wuyangshen Company used its relevant property as a guarantee for repaying its overdue loans (totaling RMB 24.36 million, of which RMB 1.62 million was interest converted into principal by the Bank of China head office) and interest. On March 12, 2000, the overdue loan collection notice from Kaili City Branch of Bank of China to Wuyangshen Company stated that Wuyangshen Company still owed loan principal including RMB 1,615,403.39 from interest conversion. Wuyangshen Company affixed its official seal on this collection notice. On May 25 and 26 of the same year, the creditor's rights transfer notice and creditor's rights confirmation form issued by Kaili City Branch of Bank of China and Nanning Office of Oriental Asset to Wuyangshen Company stated: Guizhou Branch of Bank of China transferred to Nanning Office of Oriental Asset its creditor's rights against Wuyangshen Company in the principal amount of RMB 24,355,403.39 and corresponding interest, including a claim with a principal balance of RMB 11,615,403.39. Wuyangshen Company affixed its official seal on all three notices. On June 22 of the same year, the creditor's rights transfer agreement between Guizhou Branch of Bank of China and Nanning Office of Oriental Asset stated: Guizhou Branch of Bank of China transferred to Nanning Office of Oriental Asset its creditor's rights against Wuyangshen Company as of March 31, 2000, in the principal amount of RMB 24,355,403.39 and corresponding interest. The attached list of transferred creditor's rights stated a loan principal of RMB 11,615,403.39.

On October 18, 2000, the Zhenyuan County Government and the new shareholders of Qingxi Distillery, represented by Wen Yichang, signed a property rights reform agreement for Qingxi Distillery, stipulating: The Zhenyuan County Government is willing to transfer the property rights of Qingxi Distillery to Wen Yichang and others (excluding land and goodwill intangible assets); after appraisal, the net assets of Qingxi Distillery were RMB 17.937 million, with a 15% discount, the actual price was RMB 15.247 million, to be subscribed by 199 regular employees of the distillery; upon full subscription of the net assets, the Zhenyuan County Government would recover property ownership in the form of monetary value, and Wen Yichang and others would obtain property ownership in the form of physical assets. All debts of Qingxi Distillery before the reform, totaling RMB 84.949 million (including agricultural bank loan principal and interest, taxes owed, and departmental taxes, etc.), would be assumed by Wen Yichang and others. Land use rights were temporarily not transferred for value, with the transfer price to be determined after appraisal. Before December 31, 2000, Wen Yichang and others would pay usage taxes according to state regulations. Goodwill intangible assets were temporarily not appraised, with Wen Yichang and others paying an annual intangible asset usage fee of RMB 100,000. The Zhenyuan County Government and the new shareholder representative of Qingxi Distillery, Wen Yichang, signed and sealed this agreement. The assessed liabilities of RMB 84.949 million did not include the debt involved in this case arising from the guaranty provided by Qingxi Distillery for a RMB 4 million loan to Wuyangshen Company.

On February 24, 1993, Jianhua Company's document Jianhua (93) No. 5, "Jianhua Company Announcement," stated: Cement Plant was approved to be restructured into Jianhua Company, and starting from March 1, 1993, the new seal of Jianhua Company would be officially used, and the old seal would be simultaneously invalidated; all creditor's rights, debts, and business relationships of the former Cement Plant would be assumed by Jianhua Company. However, Jianhua Company failed to prove that it made a public announcement in accordance with the law. A notarial certificate issued on December 3, 1999, (2000) Qi Gong Zheng Zi No. 07, stated that staff of Kaili City Branch of Bank of China, in the presence of a notary, served an overdue loan collection notice to Wang Yi, manager of Jianhua Company. Wang Yi signed on the overdue loan notice to Wuyangshen Company attached to the back of the notarial certificate. During the second instance trial, Jianhua Company acknowledged that Wang Yi had been its manager since 1998. On August 22, 2000, Nanning Office of Oriental Asset issued an overdue loan guaranty collection notice to Cement Plant, requesting it to bear joint and several guaranty liability for Wuyangshen Company's RMB 2.72 million loan. Cement Plant affixed its official seal on this notice.

This court, upon trial, holds: On September 3, 1993, the Bank of China head office, Guizhou Branch of Bank of China, Kaili City Branch of Bank of China, and Oil Factory signed a RMB three-level joint loan contract, stipulating that the Bank of China head office would lend RMB 10 million to Oil Factory. On June 22, 2000, when Guizhou Branch of Bank of China transferred this loan creditor's right to Nanning Office of Oriental Asset, it also transferred the interest receivable of RMB 1,615,403.39 by converting it into principal, resulting in the transferred loan principal becoming RMB 11,615,403.39. Wuyangshen Company affixed its official seal on the creditor's rights transfer notice and creditor's rights confirmation notice that recorded the above transferred principal amount and raised no objection. Accordingly, it should be determined that Wuyangshen Company knew of and consented to the conversion of interest into principal for the RMB 10 million loan. Wuyangshen Company's defense that the creditor did not notify it of the conversion of interest into principal for the RMB 10 million loan and that it did not consent is inconsistent with the facts. Guizhou Branch of Bank of China's conversion of interest into principal for the RMB 10 million principal and subsequent transfer to Nanning Office of Oriental Asset does not violate any mandatory legal provisions and shall be valid. The trial court's refusal to protect the converted interest portion on the grounds that Nanning Office of Oriental Asset did not provide relevant basis for the conversion of interest into principal of the RMB 10 million and that Wuyangshen Company did not admit it was improper. This court corrects this according to law.

On September 3, 1993, Qingxi Distillery signed a RMB three-level joint loan guaranty agreement, providing a guaranty for RMB 4 million of the RMB 15.72 million loan from the Bank of China head office, Guizhou Branch of Bank of China, and Kaili City Branch of Bank of China to Oil Factory. This represented its true intention and shall be valid. In September 2000, Qingxi Distillery was restructured into Qingjiu Group through the full purchase of its net assets by its employees. This was merely a change in the capital contributors, nature, and name of the enterprise legal person; the entity bearing civil liability did not change. The above changes do not affect its assumption of civil liability for debts incurred before the restructuring. Moreover, the property rights reform plan of Qingxi Distillery and the property rights reform agreement signed between the Zhenyuan County Government and the new shareholders of Qingxi Distillery, represented by Wen Yichang, both clearly stated that all debts of Qingxi Distillery before the reform would be assumed by the new shareholders of the post-reform enterprise. Therefore, all debts of Qingxi Distillery before the reform shall be borne by the post-reform enterprise, Qingjiu Group. Although the RMB 4 million guaranty debt of Qingxi Distillery was not included in the assessed total enterprise debt of RMB 84.949 million during the asset appraisal of the restructuring, resulting in the new shareholders of Qingjiu Group, represented by Wen Yichang, not offsetting this guaranty debt against the consideration paid for net assets, Qingjiu Group cannot use this as a reason to refuse bearing this guaranty debt against the creditor, Nanning Office of Oriental Asset. The issue of concealed or omitted debts during the enterprise restructuring between the new shareholders of Qingjiu Group and the former asset manager of Qingxi Distillery is a separate legal relationship and is not within the scope of this case. After Qingjiu Group bears the RMB 4 million guaranty debt in this case, it may separately assert its rights against the former asset manager of Qingxi Distillery. This court's "Urgent Notice on Effectively Preventing Debtors from Evading Debts in the Trial of Enterprise Bankruptcy and Restructuring Cases" provides that "in the trial of state-owned enterprise restructuring cases, if the former asset manager of the restructured enterprise conceals or omits debts during the enterprise shareholding cooperative system reform, the former asset manager of the restructured enterprise shall bear civil liability for the concealed or omitted debts." This provision is intended to define the allocation of liability between the former asset manager of the restructured enterprise and the post-reform enterprise for concealed or omitted debts arising from the fault or negligence of the former asset manager in disputes between the parties during the restructuring process. The above provision does not deny the right of the original creditor of the restructured enterprise to assert claims against the debtor in accordance with the principle of privity of contract. Therefore, this guaranty debt shall be borne by Qingjiu Group. Nanning Office of Oriental Asset's claim that Qingjiu Group should bear this guaranty debt is legally grounded and is supported by this court. The trial court's judgment dismissing Nanning Office of Oriental Asset's claim against Qingjiu Group does not comply with legal provisions and shall be amended. Nanning Office of Oriental Asset's appeal ground that the Zhenyuan County Government, without liquidating Qingxi Distillery, decided to dissolve it and recovered its land and trademark rights, and that the court should add the Zhenyuan County Government as a co-defendant and order it to bear corresponding liability for the guaranty debt in proportion to the recovered property's share of Qingxi Distillery's property, was not raised as a claim against the Zhenyuan County Government in the first instance. This is a new claim added in the second instance. According to Article 184 of the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, which provides that in the second instance procedure, if the original plaintiff adds an independent claim or the original defendant files a counterclaim, the people's court of second instance may conduct mediation on the new claim or counterclaim based on the principle of party voluntariness; if mediation fails, the parties shall be informed to file a separate lawsuit. This court will no longer review this matter in the second instance. Nanning Office of Oriental Asset may separately assert its rights against the Zhenyuan County Government.

In March 1993, Cement Plant was renamed Jianhua Company. Although its internal document, Jianhua (93) No. 5, "Jianhua Company Announcement," stated that "starting from March 1 of the same year, the new seal of Jianhua Company would be officially used, and the old seal would be simultaneously invalidated," Jianhua Company has continuously failed to prove that it simultaneously made a public announcement in accordance with the law. Moreover, Wang Yi, the manager of Jianhua Company, signed the notarial certificate (2000) Qi Gong Zheng Zi No. 07, which recorded that Kaili City Branch of Bank of China served an overdue loan collection notice to Wang Yi. Therefore, the act of providing a joint and several guaranty for the RMB 2.72 million loan to Kaili City Branch of Bank of China on October 5, 1994, in the name of Cement Plant, shall be deemed the act of Jianhua Company. Jianhua Company shall bear guaranty liability for this loan. This court supports the appeal ground of Nanning Office of Oriental Asset that Jianhua Company should bear this guaranty debt. The trial court's finding that the above guaranty act was unrelated to Jianhua Company, on the grounds that Cement Plant had been dissolved in 1993 and its seal had been declared invalid, is inconsistent with the facts and shall be amended.

In conclusion, in accordance with Article 84 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 7 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Issues Concerning Guaranty in the Trial of Economic Contract Disputes, and Article 153, Paragraph 1, Items 1, 2, and 3 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, this court hereby rules as follows:

1. Affirm Items 2, 3, and 4 of the main text of the civil judgment (2002) Qian Gao Min Er Chu Zi No. 14 of the Guizhou High People's Court;

2. Amend Item 1 of the main text of the above civil judgment to read as follows: Guizhou Wuyangshen Vegetable Oil Co., Ltd. shall, within 10 days from the effective date of this judgment, repay to China Orient Asset Management Corporation Nanning Office the principal of RMB 24,355,403.39 and interest thereon (calculated according to the interest rate agreed in the contract during the contract period, and calculated from the expiration of the contract to the date of full payment according to the overdue payment penalty rate of the People's Bank of China for the same period), and if overdue payment occurs, the matter shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Article 232 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China; China Orient Asset Management Corporation Nanning Office shall have the priority right to be repaid from the mortgaged assets of Guizhou Wuyangshen Vegetable Oil Co., Ltd.;

3. Guizhou Qingjiu Group Co., Ltd. shall bear compensatory liability for the principal and interest of the loan of RMB 4,000,000 when Guizhou Wuyangshen Vegetable Oil Co., Ltd. and the mortgaged assets of its 50-ton refined oil processing equipment are insufficient to satisfy the debt;

4. Zhenyuan County Building Materials & Chemical Company shall assume joint and several guaranty liability for the principal and interest of the loan of RMB 2,720,000 lent by Bank of China Kai Li Sub-branch to Wuyangshen Company when the mortgaged assets of Guizhou Wuyangshen Vegetable Oil Co., Ltd., including the oil distribution room and equipment, Dongfeng brand automobile, guest house, Jiaoxi office, and wastewater treatment station, are insufficient to satisfy the debt.

Court acceptance fee for the first instance: RMB 88,589.92, to be borne by Guizhou Wuyangshen Vegetable Oil Co., Ltd.; Court acceptance fee for the second instance: RMB 88,589.92, to be borne by Guizhou Wuyangshen Vegetable Oil Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 48,589.92, Guizhou Qingjiu Group Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 20,000, and Zhenyuan County Building Materials & Chemical Company in the amount of RMB 20,000.
